purpose: v0.6 baseline production source에서 시작 세이브와 방문 규칙을 생성·해시 고정했다. 결과를 보기 전에 version 2로 확정했으며 게임 기본 포획 처리는 변경하지 않는다.

legacyBaseline.heroChoice: 기존 즉시 첫 후보 선택 정책을 그대로 기록한다.

freshIdleControl.expectedProgress: Current design: zero kills/input and no automatic growth. Keep every zero and unreached sample; separate from 120-second warm-idle.

stage1.hero: after every tick, if heroReady: heroOffer then first choice heroChoose immediately; no reroll
stage1.companions: only at interval multiples, independent of hero choice visits

stage2.hero: only at companion visit: if heroReady, heroOffer and choose first; no hero actions when interval is null
stage2.order: tick → scheduled shared menu open → hero action if ready → companion tab and management → menu close

captureExperiment.comparator: existing-management-only with the same 600-second visit schedule
captureExperiment.adoptionRule: 100개 seed 각각에서5속성 파티 공격력 합이 모두 기준 이상이고 최소 한 seed·속성이 개선되며, 후보 손실·클릭 수는 각 seed에서 기준 이하일 때만 구현 검토. 영혼 지연 등 교환 비용이 있으면 자동 채택하지 않음. 2분 관리에서만 이득이면 방치 개선으로 채택하지 않음.
captureExperiment.failureRoute: 포획 상태 변경을 v0.6에서 제외하고 필수 UI 개선으로 출시 후보 생성

fixtureGeneration.policy: baseline production createEngine; fresh toSave immediately; full: two keyboard attacks then tick(1000), immediate first hero choice, no purchases or companion actions; stop after first whole-second step with exactly 30 companions

inputSchedule.perSecond: seconds 1..1800: keyboard attack twice at same engine time, then tick(1000); existing canonical cadence retained
inputSchedule.checkpointOrder: after tick, hero choice and any visit at this boundary; checkpoints share a trajectory

captureExperiment.rng: Every row reloads the exact fixture bytes and creates production mulberry32(seed). Same-seed rows may consume RNG differently after policy actions; never claim identical subsequent capture draws.

managementRules.visitTimes: positive multiples of interval through and including 1800s; no time-zero or unscheduled final settlement; null means no companion visits
managementRules.target: Among current owned companions choose minimum production companionPower; equal values use existing roster order, matching current full-roster shortcut.
managementRules.space: existing-management-only and one-pending-keep-first: if roster has 30 at visit, explicitly sacrifice the selected target once using production action, creating exactly one slot. At most one owned sacrifice per visit. Never pre-clear additional slots. current-release visits perform no roster action.
managementRules.pending: Keep first excess captured candidate outside roster; additional excess captures use unchanged release branch. At a visit, compare pre-management 5-type party sums against post-space roster plus candidate. Accept only when all five are >= and at least one is >; otherwise reject and settle by current release parity. Candidate acceptance uses empty slot; no automatic replacement. Never replace a pending candidate with a later capture.
managementRules.hero: stage1 immediate first-offer choice has its own counted visit even if it coincides with companion visit; stage2 bundles it in scheduled visit
managementRules.clickAccounting: Each companion visit costs open+companionTab+close = 3, even without a state change. Stage1 standalone ready hero costs open+heroTab+heroOffer+heroChoose+close = 5. Stage2 adds heroTab+heroOffer+heroChoose = 3 only when ready, sharing open/close. Counting is minimum scripted action count, not measured human attention, search, confirmation, or reading time.

metricDefinitions.effectivePartyPowerByType: production activeCompanions(roster, enemyType, hero.equipped), summed production effectivePower(heroBuffedPower(companionPower(c), typeOf(c.speciesId), hero.equipped), typeOf(c.speciesId), enemyType); bigint decimal strings, not DPS/PvP outcome
metricDefinitions.candidateLosses: At capture draw, mark useful if adding the candidate to roster increases top-5 sum in at least one of the five enemy types. Count useful draws finalized as releases; do not count kept or still-pending as irreversible loss. Record pending useful opportunity unavailable at checkpoint separately.
metricDefinitions.captures: Capture draw outcomes partition into ever-owned captures, finalized releases, and current pending; later explicitly sacrificed owned captures remain ever-owned and are separately counted.
metricDefinitions.souls: Record initial souls, sacrifice souls, hero-choice soul changes, release souls, terminal souls and releasedCount parity. Pending carries one unpaid release unit: floor((releasedCount+1)/RELEASES_PER_SOUL)-floor(releasedCount/RELEASES_PER_SOUL) is presently payable soul if rejected. Report pending units even when parity yields zero.
metricDefinitions.delay: For pending candidates record capturedAtSec, resolvedAtSec/null, outcome, and elapsed pending seconds at each checkpoint. Pending soul-unit-seconds and maximum wait retained; unaccepted candidate not silently settled at end.
metricDefinitions.automaticDeletionOfOwnedCompanions: 0 by adapter: deletions only from explicitly logged visit sacrifice actions. This simulated policy does not establish shipped atomic persistence/UI correctness.

captureExperiment.implementationBoundary: Measurement-only vm evaluates production compiled engine with one fail-closed exact branch hook for excess capture, preserving all other formulas/RNG/timing/actions. Instrumented current-release must equal original engine events/save under replay. Pending sidecar and settlement logic are experimental only; no default game fields or behavior are changed.
captureExperiment.adoptionScope: Evaluate 30-minute paired rows at interval 600 for each fixture and both stages separately; every 100-seed group must satisfy predeclared per-seed/per-type power/loss/click tests. Report 120 and null controls without substituting them. Any increased soul delay or unresolved exchange cost prevents automatic adoption and requires human review; no human data means conditional exclusion.

feverExperiment.otherPolicies: same frozen fresh fixture, seed1..100, immediate first hero choice, management none, purchase none
feverExperiment.decision: 같은 총입력량의 전략 차이를 기록한다. 측정만으로 피버 수치를 변경하지 않는다.
feverExperiment.timeOrder: At modeled times 0,100,...,1799900ms, deliver any scheduled input before tick(100); inspect ready hero immediately after tick and choose first. Thirty full minutes, exactly 3600 inputs per pattern. No companion management or purchases.
feverExperiment.inputConcentration: Maximum inputs in each fixed 1000ms bin and share of bins containing inputs; scheduled count verified exactly 3600.

statistics.percentile: reached 값을 정렬한 뒤 floor((n-1)*q); 미도달 수와 최대를 함께 표시
statistics.comparison: 동일 seed별 차이를 먼저 계산하며 설정 불일치 비교는 거부
statistics.bigint: Power totals/deltas are exact decimal bigint strings. Quantiles sort with bigint comparisons; never round through Number.

realE2E.missingRunVerdict: 미완료; 기술 검증·출시 완료로 체크하지 않는다.
realE2E.execution: 동일 데스크탑에서 순차 실행; 현재 runner의 신규 시작/무메뉴 정책을 기록; 새 UI 선택은 별도 journey
realE2E.matrixSupport: V06-01 구현 예정; 원본9개·해시·소스·시간·실패를 검증하며 기존 단일 파일 감사도 유지

humanObservation.interruptionBudget: 참가자별 시작 전에 합의·기록; 중단 요청과 이탈 표본도 보존
humanObservation.claimLimit: 작은 탐색의 가설 지지이며 일반적인 재미·유지율 검증이 아니다.

releaseSourceFreeze: V06-09에서 package/lock의0.6.0 버전을 먼저 반영한 뒤 최종 측정·E2E·감사. V06-10에서 버전을 다시 변경하지 않으며 지문 대상 변경 시 재검증한다.
changeControl: 실험 결과를 본 뒤 조건을 수정하면 이유와 새 protocol version을 기록하고 새 실행으로 비교한다.

측정 전에 baseline 원본에서 fixture 생성; 방문 대상·공간확보·정산·클릭·입력시간·seed pairing·fresh-idle 통계를 구체화
